result.title: UpLoop: Upcycling Large Language Models with Gated Loop
result.summary: Looped large language models trade parameter storage for recurrent computation, but most are trained from scratch. In practice, pretraining with looped depth is expensive, making post-training upcycling of a pretrained non-looped LLM an attractive alternative. We introduce \textbf{UpLoop}, a post-training recipe based on \emph{layer-wise} recurrence. Instead of looping a whole model or a middle block, UpLoop loops each selected layer locally, preserving the pretrained depth hierarchy and avoiding feature-space mismatch. To make loop execution useful, we add hidden-wise gates on the attention and MLP residual branches, so later loops act as progressive refinements rather than redundant rewrites. Empirically, UpLoop breaks the commonly observed saturation at two loops ($R=2$) in prior looped models. Starting from Qwen3-4B Base and applying SFT, UpLoop improves the average accuracy across 20 benchmarks by 6.17\% at $R=3$. We use $R=3$ as the main setting for the best accuracy--cost trade-off, while both native and extrapolated $R=4$ yield further gains.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UpLoop 后训练方案：不循环整个模型或中间块，而是让每个选定层局部循环，保留预训练深度层级；并在注意力与 MLP 残差分支上加 hidden-wise 门控，使后续循环成为渐进精化。以 Qwen3-4B 为例，R=3 时 20 个基准平均提升 6.17%，突破了此前 R=2 的饱和，R=4 仍有增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本的循环计算与状态更新线索可供核查：逐层局部循环加门控是否能迁移到 VLM latent 推理的迭代状态生成，缓解多次循环的冗余改写与饱和，并与长度泛化问题相关。
